capacity.atomicity: Wait admission recheck, lazy subscription, successful dequeue and retirement share the same gate. If dequeue occurs before subscription, current capacity is rechecked; if after subscription, exact observed TCS completes. A competing producer may refill first; caller must retry admission.
capacity.lazyAllocation: CompletedTask when capacity exists; pending TCS allocated only on actual backpressure and reused by same-epoch waiters. Dequeue nulls it and completes only previous TCS; no allocation on uncontended dequeue.
capacity.wake: RunContinuationsAsynchronously prevents inline continuation under gate. Each dequeue wakes the old waiter set even if requested buffer still does not fit. Wake means retry, not reservation or fairness.
capacity.retire: Closed state and TCS cancellation happen under gate. Old handle retains old entry; replacement identity protected by Require and Retire reference checks. Old close cannot cancel replacement TCS. Owner Done continuation invokes Close; existing host test exercises real owner completion.
capacity.scope: Internal helper has no production caller yet. This prerequisite does not itself repair outgoing queue-full exits or supply automatic retries. Future caller must retry TryEnqueue and combine its own process cancellation if needed.

native14.coverage: Nine subcases retain exact native payload label/counters/reason and malformed bytes; canonical25/27 assert real suspension/preselection snapshot and actual selected full token plus receive tracer. Active linked24, explicit26, unknown-ref28 require actual killed Completion and exact real DOWN. Genuine watcher normal death and outgoing demonitor precede malformed28 drop. Missing24, kill26 and actual deferred trailing0 reason are covered.
native14.faultHandling: Controller/watcher/receiver observations use real monitor APIs. Drain cancellation/channel closure cannot produce false pass because exact killed Completion and DOWN remain mandatory. All waits bounded; owned runtime final disposal and canonical finally release protect successful execution and normal assertion failures.
native14.limitations: Payload11 actual evidence captures selected token, not a tracer event. Tracer expectation derives from separately captured legacy13/18 receive contract. Source snapshot only checks label/serial/receive before selection, complete token after selection. Canonical ready-before-try and sequential actor disposal can replace an initial failure with a bounded cleanup error; neither turns failure green. They are diagnostic limitations, not production behavior changes.
native14.registration: Current Program contains one additive native14 registration; no old Program overlay used.
